decisions.reason: Focus unit 無大餘，小餘二十四 has a broken idiomatic (“There is large remainder is 0”); rendering 無大餘 as “the large remainder is 0” matches the chapter’s parallel treatment of 無小餘 as “the small remainder is 0,” and the proposed sentence is grammatical.

decisions.after: Zhu Li Xie Qia, the fifth year.
decisions.reason: 祝犁協洽五年 has 協洽 = xiéqià; Qiao wrongly treats 洽 as 喬, but Xia is also wrong—qià romanizes as Qia in this chapter’s syllable style, so the idiomatic must be Xie Qia.

decisions.after: Zhu Li Xie Qia fifth year.
decisions.reason: The same 協洽 in the literal is misread as Qiao; the proposal’s Xia still mismatches qià, so revise to Xie Qia while keeping the rest of the calque.
商橫涒灘建昭元年 has 涒灘 = tūntān; Dun misreads 涒 (as if 敦), and Tun Tan restores the correct year-name reading without changing the rest of the sentence.
The literal likewise has Dun Tan for 涒灘; Tun Tan matches tūntān and leaves Jian Zhao first year intact.
端蒙赤奮若竟寧元年 begins with 端蒙 = Duānméng; Duameng drops the n, and Duanmeng restores the standard reading used for this year name.
The literal’s Duameng is the same omitted-n error for 端蒙; Duanmeng is the correct romanization and otherwise preserves the calque.
